user.title: Contextual Controls
user.description: Learns locally from your commands and suggests controls. It never controls devices automatically. Phase 1 uses statistical ranking only.

data_description.included_entities: Combined with automatic domains. Explicit exclusions always win, including over pins.
data_description.included_domains: Clear this list to monitor only explicitly selected and pinned entities. Locks require explicit entity selection.

data_description.refresh_minutes: Relevant events always refresh with debounce. 15 minutes also guarantees a periodic evaluation; events-only does not update merely because the clock changed.

data_description.included_entities: Combined with automatic domains. Explicit exclusions always win, including over pins.
data_description.included_domains: Clear this list to monitor only explicitly selected and pinned entities. Locks require explicit entity selection.
data_description.all_areas: When disabled, only entities in selected areas are eligible. Entity area takes precedence over device area.

data_description.learning_period_days: Collects from installation onward; does not import Recorder history. Up to 90 days are retained locally.
data_description.time_window_minutes: Symmetric around the current local time, including midnight. ±90 at 22:30 covers 21:00–00:00.
data_description.recency_weight: 0: no decay. 100: faster decay. Recent command attempts contribute more.
data_description.learn_sources: Direct authenticated commands are manual. Assist, automation and script ancestry is used only when Home Assistant Context events identify it; uncertain calls remain unknown.
data_description.user_id: Leave empty for all users. Otherwise enter the ID from Settings → People → Users. Unattributed commands are excluded for specific profiles.
data_description.ignored_entities: Stops new learning and hides existing statistical evidence without deleting history. Pins remain visible.
data_description.consider_weekday: When enabled, matching weekdays or workday/weekend groups receive more weight.
data_description.weekday_mode: Exact compares Monday with Monday. Workday/weekend groups Monday–Friday and Saturday–Sunday.

data_description.presence_entities: Choose person, device_tracker or binary_sensor entities. Binary sensors are home while on.
data_description.presence_mode: Signal adjusts ranking. Require home hides every suggestion, including pins, unless at least one configured entity is home.
data_description.context_entities: Used only as local scoring signals and never shown as controls. Unknown and unavailable states are ignored.

data_description.pinned_entities: Order can be rearranged. Excluded or unavailable entities remain hidden.
data_description.pinned_use_slots: Enabled: 2 pins + 4 dynamic controls for a limit of 6. Disabled: 2 pins + 6 dynamic controls.

data_description.minimum_confidence: Candidates below this statistical threshold are omitted. Pins bypass it. Fewer controls are normal during learning.
data_description.cold_start: Used until an entity has three matching records. Recent controls plus pins is the default. Domain defaults is an explicit opt-in.
data_description.debug: Adds score details for up to 30 ranked candidates. May contain entity IDs; disable before sharing screenshots.

data_description.entity_id: If set, reset only this entity. Combined with a user filter, resets their intersection.
data_description.user_id: Leave empty for all users. Otherwise enter the ID from Settings → People → Users. Unattributed commands are excluded for specific profiles.
data_description.confirm: Required. With no filters, deletes all learning for this instance. Cannot be undone without a backup.
